integrity: Full analytic proof, verified Euclidean and spherical normalization, exact square identity, complete extremal degeneration classification; finite regression checks are supplementary and not an independent proof.
scientific_limitations: Only nondegenerate equifacial tetrahedra in Euclidean dimension three. Constant 6 is sharp as an unattained supremum. No assertion for general tetrahedra. Published comparison cannot exclude all unindexed work.
source_ids: Katsuura, Journal for Geometry and Graphics 25 (2021) 243-251
title: The sharp quadratic solid-angle constant for equifacial tetrahedra
